name: modern-olympos
description: Local regression and Firestore emulator authorization tests

scripts.test: node tests/regressions.cjs && node --test tests/local-browser.test.cjs tests/classroom.test.cjs tests/portraits.test.cjs
scripts.test:security: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.emulators.json --project demo-modern-olympos --only firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/firestore.security.test.cjs"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:local:auth && npm run test:security && npm run test:local:integration
scripts.test:local:integration: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.browser.json --project demo-modern-olympos-browser --only auth,firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/local-emulator.test.cjs"
scripts.test:local:auth: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.browser.json --project demo-modern-olympos-browser --only auth "node --test tests/local-auth.test.cjs"
